metrics.label: BaseRuns scored
metrics.desc: Runs the team's batting events were worth by BaseRuns (A x B / (B + C) + HR), whatever order they came in; scaled so the league's BaseRuns equal its runs.

metrics.label: BaseRuns allowed
metrics.desc: BaseRuns of the events the team's pitchers allowed (same scale).

metrics.label: BaseRuns win%
metrics.desc: BaseRuns scored^1.83 / (scored^1.83 + allowed^1.83): the record the team's events deserved, with sequencing removed. Predicts second-half win% better than Pythagorean or actual win% (MLB 2015-2026).

metrics.label: Offence (runs/game)
metrics.desc: Batting plus baserunning runs above average per game.

metrics.label: Defence (runs/game)
metrics.desc: Fielding plus framing runs per game.

metrics.label: Pitching (runs/game)
metrics.desc: Expected runs saved by the pitchers per game.

metrics.label: xwOBA+ (ours)
metrics.desc: Our xwOBA, PA-weighted over the team's hitters.

metrics.label: Pull-air%
metrics.desc: Pulled line drives and fly balls.

metrics.label: Decision value
metrics.desc: Sum of the hitters' decision value (runs).

metrics.label: Baserunning runs
metrics.desc: Sum of the hitters' baserunning runs.

metrics.label: Batting WPA
metrics.desc: Win probability added by the hitters.

metrics.label: CSW%
metrics.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per pitch.

metrics.label: Barrel% allowed
metrics.desc: Barrels allowed per ball in play.

metrics.label: Pitching RV/100
metrics.desc: Run value allowed per 100 pitches (batting side).

metrics.label: Pitching WPA
metrics.desc: Win probability added by the pitchers.

metrics.label: Savant OAA
metrics.desc: Sum of Savant OAA of the team's fielders.

metrics.label: Position-player WAR
metrics.desc: Sum of Bullpen WAR of the hitters.

metrics.label: Pitcher WAR
metrics.desc: Sum of RA9-based Bullpen WAR of the pitchers.

metrics.label: Postseason chance
metrics.desc: Probability of reaching the postseason (season simulation).

metrics.label: World Series chance
metrics.desc: Probability of winning the World Series.
